issues_outside_coverage: Child tax credit adjustment on the 2021 joint return: petitioner assigned no error, not discussed (deemed conceded)
decisive_judgment_findings: Documentary record (Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo records) traces $229,857 of cash and stock transfers out of the E*Trade IRA ending 1601 to petitioner's brokerage and checking accounts.
Petitioner had simply forgotten that the IRA account number changed from 1601 to 2205 in 2023; no evidence for his claim that E*Trade reported false distributions.
Petitioner confirmed at trial that he was under 59 1/2 in 2021; no 72(t)(2) exception claimed.
Written supervisory approval on May 20, 2024 preceded the August 2, 2024 notice and was given while the supervisor retained discretion.
Petitioner's testimony that he did not know the source of the transfers was not credible; as an experienced engineer any misunderstanding of law was not reasonable; no reasonable cause.
